_comment: Labelled utterances for the semantic query router. Add more to tune routing. Routes: analytics = needs numbers computed from the sales data (DuckDB); knowledge = definitions, schema, methodology, notebook findings (FAISS docs); general = greetings, help, small talk, off-topic.
analytics: show me sales for each category
how many orders were placed in May
which city has the most orders
how many units of kurta were sold in June
how much did revenue fall from April to June
list the top 5 styles in Western Dress
give me a breakdown of order status
which day of the week has highest sales
what share of revenue comes from Set
show expedited vs standard shipping orders
now show it as a pie chart
how many returns did we have
knowledge: what columns are in the dataset
what is the difference between fulfilment Amazon and Merchant
what does B2B mean in this data
what is the source of this dataset
what time period does the data cover
what are the key insights from the EDA
what is the objective of the analysis
what recommendations can you give to improve sales
why did revenue decline in Q2
general: how do I use this chatbot
what model are you running on
write a poem about the ocean
